## Liquid Glass like the original, your own colour, OLED mode

### Liquid Glass (only in the Liquid Glass theme)
- **Glass that reacts to your finger:** buttons swell a little when pressed, light wells up inside the glass from the point you touch and spreads, the glass follows your finger and springs back with a soft wobble when you let go
- **Menus grow out of their button:** a menu swells out of the button (or the spot) that opened it like a drop, and melts back into it when it closes
- **Materialising panes:** sheets, dialogs, the device picker and messages appear by bending the light strongly at first and settling into clear glass. Switching to Liquid Glass makes every bar materialise
- **Magnifying tab bar lens:** hold and drag the pill in the phone tab bar and it lifts off as a thicker lens that magnifies the icons underneath
- **Tab bar shrinks while scrolling (phone):** scroll down and the tab bar shrinks to the open tab, the mini player moves down beside it. Scroll up or tap it to bring it back
- **Glass switches and sliders:** a held switch turns its knob into a clear glass drop, a dragged slider thumb becomes a glass pill and the track grows

### Your own accent colour
- New "Own colour" swatch next to the colours: a field for saturation and brightness, a hue strip, hex input (#abc or #aabbcc), recently used colours and ideas
- On Windows and in Chrome a pipette picks a colour from anywhere on the screen
- The whole app takes the colour live while you drag. It stays readable in light and dark mode, and text on it turns dark or white by itself
- Works in every theme, also in the start assistant

### OLED mode
- New switch under Settings → General: pure black instead of dark grey, for every theme. It is a setting of dark mode, so it only shows and only works in dark mode

### Fixes
- Every tap anywhere in the app re-applied the accent colour in the background. Fixed
- Light Liquid Glass: the bar with "Next" in the start assistant no longer shows a black band

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android:** Settings → Updates → Update now
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new installer
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates
